convert_animatediff_motion_lora_to_diffu: run the script to convert an AnimationDiff motion LoRA checkpoint to Diffusers format and save as safetensors
convert_motion_module: convert an AnimationDiff motion module state dict to Diffusers naming convention by remapping layer keys
push_to_hub: run the conversion script with --push_to_hub to upload the converted model to the HuggingFace Hub
load_checkpoint_safetensors_or_torch: load a checkpoint from either a safetensors file or a torch pickle file and extract the state dict
refactor_convert_motion_module: refactor convert_motion_module to support additional key remapping rules for new AnimationDiff layer naming patterns
